value.text: GitHub issue 757 is an instance of this class rather than a new defect. Same generator, same root cause: the recovery bundle derives flag suggestions from error-message prose instead of from the invoked command's declared flag contract. The new dimension it adds is cross-command leakage — --validate-close is a real pm flag, just not one pm update accepts — and a case where the correct recovery is a command redirect (use pm close) rather than any flag at all. Fixing this item must cover both: reject undeclared flags, and emit a command-level suggestion when no flag on the invoked command can resolve the failure. Sibling pm-ulqu stays separate: it is about rendering an enum flag's allowed values and about blocker ordering on a command that does accept the flag.
